'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Attacks in Russia during the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[2024 Western Russia incursion]]
****The [[Freedom of Russia Legion]], the [[Sibir Battalion]], and the [[Russian Volunteer Corps]] enter [[Belgorod Oblast|Belgorod]] and [[Kursk Oblast|Kursk]] [[Oblasts of Russia|oblasts]]. [[Russia]] claims to have repelled the attacks. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/live/2024/mar/12/russia-ukraine-war-live-latest-news-updates (''The Guardian'')]
***[[Ukraine]] launches 25 drones at Russian cities, hitting a major [[oil refinery]] in [[Nizhny Novgorod Oblast]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/live/2024/mar/12/russia-ukraine-war-live-latest-news-updates (''The Guardian'')]
**[[2024 Ivanovo Ilyushin Il-76 crash]]
***A [[Russian Aerospace Forces]] [[Ilyushin Il-76]] military transport plane with 15 people on board crashes in [[Ivanovo Oblast]], Russia. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/live/2024/mar/12/russia-ukraine-war-live-latest-news-updates (''The Guardian'')]
**[[Bombing of Kryvyi Rih (2022–present)|Bombing of Kryvyi Rih]]
***Three people are killed and at least 36 others are injured in a Russian [[missile]] strike on apartment buildings in [[Kryvyi Rih]], [[Dnipropetrovsk Oblast]], Ukraine. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/missile-hits-apartment-building-kryvyi-rih-two-dead-ukrainian-president-says-2024-03-12/ (Reuters)]
*[[2024 Iran–Israel conflict]], [[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
**Two Hezbollah militants and killed and six injured in [[Israeli Air Force|Israeli]] [[airstrike]]s on "[[Hezbollah]] military command centers" in [[Lebanon]]'s [[Beqaa Valley]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/lebanons-hezbollah-fires-more-than-100-katyusha-rockets-onto-israel-2024-03-12/ (Reuters)]
**Hezbollah launches more than 100 [[Katyusha rocket launcher|Katyusha rockets]] into northern [[Israel]], targeting several [[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli military]] outposts. [https://www.nytimes.com/2024/03/12/world/middleeast/hezbollah-rockets-israel-lebanon.html (''The New York Times'')]
*[[Piracy off the coast of Somalia]]
**About 20 armed [[pirate]]s hijack a [[Bangladesh]]i [[bulk carrier]] in the [[Indian Ocean]] that was en route to the [[United Arab Emirates]]. The vessel is under the control of the pirates and is heading towards the coast of [[Somalia]]. [https://www.thenationalnews.com/world/2024/03/12/pirates-board-bangladeshi-ship-off-coast-of-somalia/?utm_source=twitter&utm_medium=socialsharebtn&related=TheNatWorld,NationalComment,LifeNationalUAE,NatSportUAE&via=TheNationalNews (''The National News'')]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**The [[Sudanese Army]] says that it has taken control of the national television and radio broadcaster in [[Omdurman]] from the [[Rapid Support Forces]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/sudans-army-says-it-took-control-national-radio-television-hq-statement-2024-03-12/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Nine people are killed and two others are injured after a three-story residential building collapses in [[Multan]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://apnews.com/article/pakistan-building-collapse-multan-f7c16ac0f65f2efedbc0908e20fab5b4 (AP News)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Argentina–Venezuela relations]]
**[[Argentina]] announces diplomatic actions against [[Venezuela]] after president [[Nicolás Maduro]] banned Argentina-licensed aircraft from entering Venezuelan airspace amid deteriorating relations between the two countries. [https://www.sandiegouniontribune.com/en-espanol/noticias/story/2024-03-12/argentina-cuestiona-a-venezuela-por-prohibicion-de-sobrevuelo-de-aeronaves-sobre-su-territorio (''The San Diego Union-Tribune'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Lithuania and the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**The opposition politician [[Leonid Volkov (politician)|Leonid Volkov]] is attacked outside his home in [[Vilnius]], Lithuania, apparently on orders by [[Vladimir Putin]]. The incident is being investigated as a terror crime. [https://www.aljazeera.com/amp/news/2024/3/13/navalny-ally-leonid-volkov-attacked-with-hammer-near-lithuanian-home (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Israeli Police]] kill a 13-year-old boy who allegedly fired fireworks at them in [[Shuafat]], [[East Jerusalem]]. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/middle-east/2024/03/13/Israeli-border-police-shoots-dead-12-year-old-Palestinian-boy-in-east-Jerusalem/ (Al Arabiya)]
*[[Capital punishment in Japan]]
**A court in [[Fukuoka Prefecture]], [[Japan]], overturns the death sentence of [[Yakuza]] [[Kudo-kai]] leader [[Satoru Nomura]] and sentences him to [[life in prison]]. Nomura had originally been sentenced to death for a 1998 murder. [https://mainichi.jp/english/articles/20240312/p2g/00m/0na/045000c (''The Mainichi'')]
*Three [[Copts|Coptic Christian]] [[monk]]s from [[Egypt]] are killed during a [[mass stabbing]] at a [[monastery]] in [[Cullinan, South Africa|Cullinan]], [[South Africa]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/three-coptic-egyptian-monks-killed-south-africa-coptic-orthodox-church-says-2024-03-12/ (Reuters)]
*A [[Romania]]n court rules that [[social media]] influencer [[Andrew Tate]] and his brother [[Tristan Tate]] can be [[extradition|extradited]] to the [[United Kingdom]] to face charges of sexual aggression. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-68547871 (BBC News)]
*[[Zimbabwe]]an police arrest a self-proclaimed prophet and rescue 251 children from a compound operated by his followers. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2024/mar/14/zimbabwe-police-arrest-apostolic-prophet-and-rescue-251-children-from-compound (''The Guardian'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2024 United States presidential election]]
**[[2024 Democratic Party presidential primaries]]
***The [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democratic Party]] holds presidential nominating contests in [[2024 Georgia Democratic presidential primary|Georgia]], [[2024 Mississippi Democratic presidential primary|Mississippi]], the [[2024 Northern Mariana Islands Democratic presidential caucuses|Northern Mariana Islands]], and [[2024 Washington Democratic presidential primary|Washington]]. [[Democrats Abroad]] also concludes [[2024 Democrats Abroad presidential primary|its primary]]. [https://apnews.com/article/march-12-presidential-contests-georgia-mississippi-washington-hawaii-97bc332080e9dd3563f14006d2a7e479 (AP)]
***Incumbent [[President of the United States|President]] [[Joe Biden]] officially surpasses the 1,968 delegate threshold needed to become the presumptive Democratic Party nominee for President. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/politics/2024/03/12/election-2024-trump-biden-georgia-mississippi-washington-hawaii-primary/ (''The Washington Post'')]
**[[2024 Republican Party presidential primaries]]
***The [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican Party]] holds presidential nominating contests in [[2024 Georgia Republican presidential primary|Georgia]], [[2024 Hawaii Republican presidential caucuses|Hawaii]], [[2024 Mississippi Republican presidential primary|Mississippi]], and [[2024 Washington Republican presidential primary|Washington]]. [https://apnews.com/article/march-12-presidential-contests-georgia-mississippi-washington-hawaii-97bc332080e9dd3563f14006d2a7e479 (AP)]
***Former President [[Donald Trump]] officially surpasses the 1,215 delegate threshold needed to win his third consecutive Republican Party nomination for President, joining [[Richard Nixon]] as the only people in U.S. history to win the Republican nomination thrice. [https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/2024-election/trump-delegates-gop-nomination-biden-election-rcna142490 (NBC News)]

*A scientific expedition to the [[Bounty Trough]] off the coast of [[New Zealand]] reports the discovery of more than one hundred new species. [https://www.nytimes.com/2024/03/10/science/new-species-sea-discovery.html (''The New York Times'')]
